// transcoracle -- pown / rootn oracle vectors that need the D48 domain
// (D48SwiftWorkOrder.md Phase 6). Moved from pown.txt (the 615 negative-n lines)
// and rootn.txt (24 lines). Expected values are NOT port output (see each block).
// Ports still on D38 fail about 309 of the pown lines, so they exclude this file in
// native.exclude until their D48 switch. Lines D48 still misses are commented with
// the reason and the D48 answer every port must give:
//   // gap: <line> | d48: <D48 result>         the documented 1-ulp gap near 1
//                                              (CrossPlatformArchitecture.md)
//   // pow-cohort: <line> | d48: <result>      pow's applyPreferredScale bug (punchlist)

// Negative n under all five rounding directions. Expected values are NOT port
// output: x^n is computed exactly with Python integers and rounded ONCE by
// Python decimal in a decimal128 context (prec=34, Emax=6144, Emin=-6143,
// clamp=1). Exact results take the exponent closest to the preferred exponent
// n*Q(x) (IEEE 754-2019 5.2). Where |n| is too large for exact integers
// (|n| * digits > 10^6; never an exact result) the value is exp(n*ln|x|) at 80
// and 120 digits, which must round alike.

// Subnormal results for 1 <= |x| < 10 (raise-first overflowed to 0 + Overflow).
